title: one shared tooltip component for the whole project + placement that never hides under the mouse cursor

decisions.text: Single placement rule: a tooltip goes ABOVE the cursor/element (owner req. 1). Rationale (geometry): the standard arrow cursor's hotspot is at its tip (top-left) and the glyph extends DOWN-RIGHT (~20x20 CSS px at 100%), so anything drawn below-right of the hotspot is covered by the cursor while anything ABOVE it never is. Cursors with a centred hotspot (crosshair on canvases, text I-beam, ns-/ew-resize) do extend upward ~10-16px, hence a single constant CURSOR_CLEARANCE_PX = 24 that clears both. Primary direction = up; fallback (no room above) = down but with a gap >= CURSOR_CLEARANCE_PX so the arrow glyph cannot cover the text. NOTE: 'above' satisfies BOTH readings of req 1 at once -- it neither overlaps the cursor nor sits under it -- so no owner clarification is needed; see R6 on the literal z-order reading.

CANCELLED (owner 2026-07-15, req 3). Was: flip the q-tooltip default globally by mutating QTooltip.props.anchor/self.default from a boot file, so all 71 bare call sites move at once without touching them. The owner chose a single shared component instead -- that component is now the one place anchor/self/offset are set, so the boot hack is unnecessary. This also CLOSES R2 (the hack depended on the private shape of QTooltip.props and would silently stop applying on a Quasar upgrade). The component is strictly better: the rule is visible in code rather than hidden in a boot file.

Where the shared component lives: MindWaveCore + a '@tooltip' alias, modelled on the existing PW-D8 precedent (owner req. 3). New MindWaveCore/ui/src/components/tooltip/ (AppTooltip.vue + tooltip-place.ts); Vite alias '@tooltip' in quasar.config.ts:27-31 next to '@panel'; tsconfig.json paths "@tooltip/*": ["./src/components/tooltip/*"]. Any repo then imports it as `import AppTooltip from '@tooltip/AppTooltip.vue'` -- exactly how GnauralCore already imports '@panel/PanelWindow.vue' (FileOpenDialog.vue:26). This is a proven mechanism, not a new invention: quasar.config.ts:29 literally carries the comment 'PW1.1 (PW-D8): the universal panel control, importable from module repos'. Module repos need no paths of their own because vue-tsc runs from MindWaveCore/ui and pulls their files in through the import graph. Component name (AppTooltip / <app-tooltip>) to be confirmed by the owner at TT1.3.

Component API: two binding modes so the canvas tooltips also fall under req 3. One component, one look, one placement rule (TT-D1), two ways to bind: (1) ELEMENT mode (default) -- renders <q-tooltip anchor='top middle' self='bottom middle'> internally; covers families A (71 q-tooltips) and C (~17 native titles). offset stays [14,14]: with anchor:'top' the tooltip's bottom edge lands 14px above the element's top edge, and since the cursor is INSIDE the element with the arrow extending down-right, there is no overlap. (2) CURSOR mode -- a prop like :at="{x, y}" (viewport coords), Teleport to <body> + position:fixed, positioned by placeCursorTooltip (TT-D3); covers family B (2 canvas tooltips). Why one component for both: otherwise the canvas tooltips stay outside req 3 and drift apart again in style and rule -- which is exactly what has already happened (they currently disagree on coord space, offset, z-index and edge handling).

Pure placement module tooltip-place.ts + bun tests -- the single source of truth for the rule. placeCursorTooltip({x, y, w, h, bounds, clearance}) -> {left, top}: above by default (top = y - h - clearance); flip below with the same clearance when there is no room above (top = y + clearance); horizontal left = x + 14 with a left-flip near the right edge and a final clamp into bounds (pad = 8). Pure TS, no Vue, so `bun test` covers it. Lives next to the component (@tooltip/tooltip-place.ts). Precedent: time-format.ts (SB-D4).

Family B moves onto the component (cursor mode). GTrackView.positionTooltip() (GTrackView.vue:270-290 -- the whole +14/+14 arithmetic, flip and clamp) and SpectrogramView (SpectrogramView.vue:813, +12/+12, no clamp at all) are deleted; both render <app-tooltip :at="hoverPos">. SpectrogramView thereby also gains the clamping it lacks and moves to viewport coords (clientX/Y) -- that is a requirement of cursor mode, not a separate option (R4).

Family C: native title="" -> the component (req 3; NO LONGER optional). Previously 'proposed, droppable whole'; req 3 makes conversion MANDATORY -- a native tooltip's position cannot be controlled from code, so conversion is the only way to satisfy req 1 AND req 3 for these ~17. Side effect: style and delay change (OS ~500ms -> Quasar 0ms), a visible change, so show it to the owner at TT1.3. aria-label preserved. EXCLUDED: TrackListDialog.vue:10 and FileOpenDialog.vue:8, where `title` is a PanelWindow prop, not a DOM attribute.

Family D (5 ECharts charts, BodyMonitorCore): OUT OF SCOPE ENTIRELY (req 4; LOCKED owner 2026-07-15). Owner: 'let ECharts keep its own mechanism, we don't touch it'. BOTH previously proposed options are rejected -- (a) tooltip.show:false + <app-tooltip>, and (b) the shared position callback onto tooltip-place.ts. The 5 BodyMonitorCore charts are not touched at all. Consequences to remember: (1) req 3 now carries a DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION -- 'all tooltips via the component' means families A/B/C; (2) ECharts tooltips may still land under the cursor (req 1 does not apply to them) -- this is a deliberate exception, not an unfinished job, recorded so a later session does not 'fix' it by mistake; (3) phase 3 is dropped and R7 is closed; (4) the TT-D9 guard MUST NOT flag ECharts.

AppTooltip picks the side ITSELF in element mode; QTooltip's own flip is never relied on (owner feedback 2026-07-15 at TT1.3, R1 realised). Found via the owner's report that the MainLayout status-icon tooltip rendered with a scrollbar over one word. Cause, read out of Quasar's source: with anchor:'top'/self:'bottom' an element near the top of the window makes props.top < 0, so applyBoundaries (position-engine.js:303-343) fires and does TWO things -- it flips the box below (props.top = anchorProps.bottom) AND pins props.maxHeight to the tooltip's own ROUNDED offsetHeight. A fractional content height (10px tooltip font) then exceeds that integer box by a sub-pixel and .q-tooltip's `overflow-y: auto` draws a scrollbar. The flip alone was also a silent regression of req 1: it uses a flat 14px gap, which the ~20px arrow glyph still covers. Fix: onBeforeShow measures the anchor (QTooltip anchors to its own parentNode) and, when hasRoomAbove() is false, we set anchor:'bottom'/self:'top' with offset [14, CURSOR_CLEARANCE_PX] ourselves. props.top then stays > 0, so the engine never applies boundaries, never sets max-height and never scrolls -- and the fallback clears the cursor. One threshold (MIN_ROOM_ABOVE_PX = 48) in the pure module, unit-tested, deliberately tight so it catches the header but not the toolbars.

Enforcement: a guard test instead of a lint rule (req 3, 'all subsequent tooltips'). There is NO ESLint in the project at all (no config, no script; MindWaveCore/ui has only dev/build/typecheck), so 'must use the component' cannot be expressed as a lint rule -- it needs its own guard: a bun test that scans the three repos' sources and fails on a raw <q-tooltip outside AppTooltip.vue, on title="/:title=" on DOM elements, and on hand-rolled tooltip divs. An ALLOWLIST is mandatory or it false-positives (R8): AppTooltip.vue (the only legal q-tooltip), `title`-as-a-prop on PanelWindow (TrackListDialog.vue:10, FileOpenDialog.vue:8), and the 5 BodyMonitorCore ECharts charts (req 4 -- out of scope, must not be flagged). Without this step req 3 is documentation, not a rule.

steps.title: Модуль tooltip-place.ts: placeCursorTooltip + CURSOR_CLEARANCE_PX + bun-тесты
steps.verify: bun test (выше по умолчанию; флип вниз с зазором >= clearance при нехватке места сверху; флип влево у правого края; кламп в углах; вырожденные bounds)
evidence: tooltip-place.ts: CURSOR_CLEARANCE_PX=24 / CURSOR_OFFSET_X_PX=14 / EDGE_PAD_PX=8 + placeCursorTooltip(). Vertical is above-first and flips DOWN only when the box would leave the top edge -- the inverse of the old hand-rolled logic, which started below and flipped up only on overflow. Horizontal keeps the existing +14 right-of-hotspot with a left-flip near the right edge. clampRange() degrades to `min wins` on an inverted range so a box bigger than the viewport clamps to the pad instead of going negative.

tooltip-place.test.ts: 18 tests / 24 expect() pass (bun test ui/src/components/tooltip). Covers: above by default; whole box proven above the hotspot (top+h <= y-clearance, i.e. the arrow cannot reach it); fallback below keeps >= clearance; the exact flip boundary (y = pad+h+clearance flips at y-1, not before); all four corners; custom clearance (R3 escape hatch); degenerate bounds (taller/wider than viewport, zero-size -> no NaN/Infinity).
Rule is Vue-free and lives in one module, so AppTooltip's cursor mode (TT1.2) and any future caller share it.

steps.title: AppTooltip.vue + алиас @tooltip (quasar.config + tsconfig) + 2-3 показательных места (req 3)
steps.verify: vue-tsc + quasar build; manual: тултип появляется НАД элементом, курсор его не накрывает; импорт '@tooltip/AppTooltip.vue' резолвится из GnauralCore
evidence: AppTooltip.vue: two modes, one look. Element mode wraps QTooltip with anchor='top middle' self='bottom middle' placed AFTER v-bind=$attrs so a caller cannot quietly opt out of the rule. Cursor mode (:at={x,y}) teleports to <body> and positions via placeCursorTooltip. Mode is chosen by whether `at` was PASSED (props.at !== undefined), so :at='null' (nothing hovered) still means cursor mode instead of degenerating into an unanchored element tooltip.

Look is inherited, not copied: the cursor-mode div reuses Quasar's own classes. QTooltip.sass splits .q-tooltip (position:fixed !important + z-index + padding + max-w/h) from .q-tooltip--style (font/colour/radius), so 'q-tooltip q-tooltip--style no-pointer-events' matches QTooltip.js:334's own class list exactly -- both modes are identical by construction, and there are no duplicated colour values to drift.

Two-pass measure uses visibility:hidden on the first pass rather than parking the box at a guessed position (which is what GTrackView does today): a guess would flash for one frame below-right of the pointer -- precisely the bug being fixed.

Alias wired like PW-D8: quasar.config.ts '@tooltip' next to '@panel' + tsconfig paths '@tooltip/*'. Verified cross-repo: GnauralTransportControls.vue (GnauralCore) imports '@tooltip/AppTooltip.vue' and the build emits AppTooltip.vue_vue_type_script_setup_true_lang-D-VeDw19.js, i.e. the alias resolved from a module repo, not just from the host.

Anchor resolution checked against Quasar source, not assumed: use-portal.js:132-137 renderPortal returns undefined while hidden, so QTooltip leaves an inline comment node; use-anchor.js:156-164 pickAnchorEl reads proxy.$el.parentNode of the QTooltip instance itself (not the wrapper), so wrapping it in AppTooltip leaves the anchor as the host element (<q-icon>) exactly as before.

Converted 4 tooltips across 2 repos as the demo set: MainLayout.vue:6,9 (deliberately the R1 top-of-viewport case) and GnauralTransportControls.vue:16,26. vue-tsc --noEmit: 0 errors. quasar build: ok; tooltip-place.test.ts not bundled.
NOT yet exercised: cursor mode has no caller until TT2.3/TT2.4 -- only element mode is visible at the TT1.3 PAUSE.

Инфо: буквальное «поверх курсора» по z-order невыполнимо (курсор рисует ОС); «выше» удовлетворяет обе формулировки req 1 — см. план §1.1 и R6
Инфо: cursor mode пока НЕ задействован ни одним вызовом — тултип узла GTrackView и readout спектрограммы (вероятная суть req 2) переезжают в TT2.3/TT2.4, каждый по одному файлу.
Вопрос про ECharts снят — req 4 (не трогаем).

steps.title: Доработки по проверке TT1.3 (owner feedback #1): скролл в тултипе иконки шапки
steps.verify: bun test (24/24); vue-tsc 0; quasar build ok; manual: тултип иконки bun БЕЗ скролла и не под курсором; транспорт по-прежнему над кнопкой
evidence: Owner feedback #1 (TT1.3): «Тултип иконки bun стала отображатся со скролом» + screenshot -- a vertical scrollbar next to the single word 'Bun'. Feedback #2: transport tooltips OK. R1 materialised, and worse than predicted: not just a flip back down, but a spurious scrollbar.

Root cause traced in Quasar source (not guessed): applyBoundaries pins props.maxHeight to the tooltip's ROUNDED offsetHeight when it nudges the box inside the viewport; fractional content height at the 10px tooltip font then overflows that integer box by a sub-pixel, and .q-tooltip's overflow-y:auto turns that into a scrollbar. The same flip also re-broke req 1 silently (flat 14px gap < the ~20px arrow glyph) -- the owner only saw the scrollbar, but both were wrong.

Fix (TT-D10): stop relying on QTooltip's flip. AppTooltip.onBeforeShow measures the anchor (its own parentNode) and, when hasRoomAbove() is false, sets anchor:'bottom'/self:'top' + offset [14,24] itself -> props.top > 0 -> boundaries never fire -> no max-height, no scrollbar, and the fallback clears the cursor.

hasRoomAbove + MIN_ROOM_ABOVE_PX=48 added to the pure module: 6 new tests pin the actual geometry -- header icon at 15px -> below; toolbar at 60/120px -> above (must not catch the toolbars the owner confirmed good); inclusive boundary; threshold >= offset + two lines. bun test 24/24, 33 expect(); vue-tsc 0; quasar build succeeded.

steps.title: ECharts: 5 графиков BodyMonitorCore — СНЯТО (req 4: «в ECharts пусть остаётся свой механизм, его не трогаем»)
steps.blockedReason: Owner 2026-07-15 (req 4): ECharts keeps its own mechanism, untouched. Not a backlog item -- a closed decision (TT-D6). Family D therefore stays outside req 1 and req 3 by design; do not 'fix' it later without a new owner request.

log.text: Plan + ledger created for tooltip placement (owner req. 2026-07-15): tooltips must not be covered by the mouse cursor -- today they render below/under it and the cursor blocks the text. Root cause is geometric: the arrow cursor's hotspot is its top-left tip and the glyph extends DOWN-RIGHT, which is exactly where every tooltip family currently places itself. Decisions TT-D1..D6 proposed; owner review at the PAUSE.

Inventory (verified, full workspace sweep): FOUR tooltip families, not one. (A) 71 <q-tooltip> across 17 files -- every one bare, so all inherit Quasar 2.19.3 defaults anchor:'bottom middle' / self:'top middle' / offset:[14,14] (QTooltip.js:69-83) = always below the element. No global config (quasar.config.ts:94-100 framework.config = {dark:true}) and no wrapper component exist. (B) 2 hand-rolled cursor-following divs: GTrackView.vue:270-290 (+14/+14 from clientX/Y, teleported+fixed, flips only on right/bottom overflow) and SpectrogramView.vue:813 (+12/+12 from offsetX/Y, absolute, no clamp/flip at all). (C) ~17 native title="" (OS-drawn, position not controllable). (D) 5 ECharts charts with no position callback. Density: TracksPanel.vue alone has 20 q-tooltips. Total ~90 call sites across 3 repos.

Two findings that shaped the plan. (1) R1, verified in position-engine.js:303-343 (applyBoundaries): flipping to anchor:'top'/self:'bottom' does NOT hold near the top of the viewport -- when props.top < 0 and the anchor is in the upper half, Quasar re-flips the tooltip BELOW the element (props.top = Math.max(0, anchorProps.bottom)), i.e. back under the cursor. Affects the MainLayout.vue:6,9 header tooltips; the Tracks toolbar sits below the app header so its 20 tooltips have room above. (2) The auto-import map (quasar/dist/transforms/import-map.json) rewrites <q-tooltip> to `import { QTooltip } from 'quasar'` -> a single shared module instance. That was what made the one-file boot override viable -- and equally what makes app.component('QTooltip', ...) NOT work, since auto-import shadows global registration.

Scope note: the owner's req 2 wording ('тултип отображается ниже и под курсором') most precisely matches family B -- +12..14px down-right of the hotspot is directly under the ~20px arrow glyph, covering the tooltip's top-left corner where the first line of text starts. Telling detail: SpectrogramView.vue:812 already carries the comment 'offset a little so it doesn't sit under the pointer' -- the intent was right, the direction of the offset was wrong.

Owner follow-up (2026-07-15, req 3): ALL tooltips in the project must go through ONE shared component, and all future tooltips must use it. This REPLACES TT-D2 (the boot-file QTooltip.props mutation is cancelled) and CLOSES R2 with it -- no more dependence on Quasar's private prop shape; the component is now the single place anchor/self/offset live. Knock-on changes: TT-D5 (native title -> component) is promoted from 'proposed/droppable' to MANDATORY; family B (canvas tooltips) must also route through the component, so TT-D8 gives it two modes (element / cursor) rather than being element-only; new TT-D7 (component location + '@tooltip' alias) and TT-D9 (enforcement guard) added. Scope grew from 'one boot file' to ~90 call sites in 3 repos -> steps re-cut by family and a PAUSE (TT1.3) inserted BEFORE the mass migration so the API is approved on 2-3 sites first (R5).

Phase 1 done, parked at the TT1.3 PAUSE. TT1.1 (efb81a7): tooltip-place.ts + 18 tests. TT1.2 (MindWaveCore a9f0e82 + GnauralCore fc02753): AppTooltip.vue + the '@tooltip' alias, 4 tooltips converted across 2 repos as the demo set. vue-tsc 0 errors, quasar build ok. Two things were verified against Quasar's source rather than assumed: (1) wrapping QTooltip in a component does NOT break its anchor -- use-portal.js:132-137 returns undefined while hidden so QTooltip leaves an inline comment node, and use-anchor.js:156-164 reads proxy.$el.parentNode of the QTooltip instance itself, so the anchor stays the host element; (2) QTooltip.sass splits .q-tooltip (positioning) from .q-tooltip--style (appearance), so cursor mode inherits the look via Quasar's own classes instead of copying colour values that could drift. The rules file (root repo 352bfc0) now carries the decision, imported into Claude Code via a new CLAUDE.md since Claude Code never reads AGENTS.md. Mass migration (~90 sites) deliberately NOT started -- that is what the PAUSE is for.

Owner decision (2026-07-15, req 4): 'in ECharts let its own mechanism stay, we don't touch it'. Family D is out of scope ENTIRELY -- both option (a) and the recommended option (b) are rejected, so not even a position callback. TT-D6 locked, step TT3.1 -> deferred (a closed decision, not backlog), phase 3 dropped, R7 closed, TT-D9's allowlist gains the 5 chart files. Net effect: req 3 ('all tooltips via one component') now has a documented exception -- it means families A/B/C -- and ECharts tooltips may still sit under the cursor by design. Recorded explicitly so a later session does not read it as an unfinished job. Scope drops from ~95 to ~90 call sites.

Precedent found for req 3, so the shared component needs no new mechanism: PW1.1/PW-D8 already does exactly this for the panel control. quasar.config.ts:27-31 carries `'@panel': resolve(currentDir, 'src', 'components', 'panel')` with the comment 'the universal panel control, importable from module repos'; tsconfig.json mirrors it as "@panel/*": ["./src/components/panel/*"]; and GnauralCore consumes it at FileOpenDialog.vue:26 via `import PanelWindow from '@panel/PanelWindow.vue'`. TT-D7 clones that shape for '@tooltip'. Also established: there is NO ESLint anywhere in the project (MindWaveCore/ui has only dev/build/typecheck), so req 3's 'all subsequent tooltips' cannot be a lint rule -> TT-D9 guard test. Bun tests exist in GnauralCore (19 files, incl. ui/composables) and MindWaveCore (3, all under server/).
